description: This Dart source file defines the main gameplay screen for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe game. It manages game state, user interactions, and UI layout, including the game board, status bar, and reset button.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Main stateful widget representing the game interface, including the game board, status indicator, and reset button.

classes.name: _GameScreenState
classes.description: State class for GameScreen, managing game logic, UI updates, and interaction handling.

methods.name: _resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game board and state to start a new game.

methods.name: _evaluateBoard
methods.description: Checks the current board for a winner or a draw after each move.

methods.name: _onTapCell
methods.description: Handles user's tap on a cell, updates game state, and checks for game conclusion.

methods.name: _statusText
methods.description: Determines the status message based on current game state.

methods.name: _statusAccent
methods.description: Determines the color accent for the status message based on game state.

methods.name: _isWinningCell
methods.description: Checks if a particular cell is part of the winning line.

methods.name: _buildBoard
methods.description: Builds the 3x3 game board grid widget.
